title: Steel Plant Manager
text:
PLANT MANAGER

\*WE ARE LOOKING FOR THREE PLANT MANAGERS TO SUPPORT OUR STEEL PROCESSING FACILITIES: GARY, IN; OIL CITY, PA ; WASHINGTON, PA.

The Plant Manager will manage and oversee all aspects of plant operations (safety, quality, production etc.) as well as P&L. They will oversee securing customer contracts and new business opportunities. They combine business knowledge with technical knowledge to optimize profitability and efficiency when it comes to the related products and/or services.

· Identify, implement, and support safety, environmental, lean manufacturing, quality, and process improvements.

· Directly supervisor employees in HR, Accounting, Purchasing and Operations.

* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; address complaints and resolving problems.
* Lead teams in achieving performance goals associated with safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Allocate and manage resources (labor, capacity, and materials) to optimize productivity.
* Participate in product team meetings to help effectively improve product line performance and strategic planning.
* Demonstrate initiative and willingness to find improvements using Lean Manufacturing.
* Ability to respond quickly to a shifting reality and adjust initiatives and priorities accordingly.

· A minimum of 6+ years of experience in manufacturing/machine shop environment.

· Must have experience leading teams within a steel/machining environment.

· P&L experience.

· Experience using Lean Manufacturing principles to reduce waste and improve efficiency.

· Leadership experience in a union environment.

· Must have experience within a continuous casting environment.

· Providing leadership, coaching, and/or mentoring to operations employees.

· Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers.

· Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Excel and Word.

· Organizational skills and the flexibility to juggle a variety of functions and projects.

· **﻿**Sales background a plus.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
